# Load Data

```{r}
# Helper function to read csv if it exists
read_data <- function(path, study_name) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    message(paste("Reading", study_name))
    df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(study = study_name)
    return(df)
  } else {
    warning(paste("File not found:", path))
    return(NULL)
  }
}
```

# Standardization Functions

```{r}
standardize_cols <- function(df) {
  
  # Ensure character type for study to avoid errors if missing
  if(!"study" %in% names(df)) df$study <- NA_character_
  
  # Define a safe getter that doesn't crash if the column is missing
  get_col <- function(data, candidates) {
    for (col in candidates) {
      if (col %in% names(data)) {
        return(as.character(data[[col]]))
      }
    }
    return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(data)))
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      # ID
      id = get_col(., c("subject_id", "recid", "individual")),
      
      # Demographics
      age = get_col(., c("age", "Age", "AGE")),
      gender = get_col(., c("gender", "sex", "Gender", "Sex", "GENDER", "SEX", "gender0")),

      # Ethnicity (International)
      ethnicity = get_col(., c("ethnic_label", "ethnicity")),
      
      # Aboriginal Status (Australian)
      aboriginal = get_col(., c("atsi", "atsi2", "indigenous", "aboriginal", "tsi", "atsistatus")),
      
      # HIV
      hiv = get_col(., c("hiv", "hiv_ab_label", "hiv_ab", "schiv")),
      
      # HCV
      hcv = get_col(., c("hcv", "HCV", "hcv_rna", "hcv_status")),
      
      # HBV
      hbv = get_col(., c("hbv", "hbv_sag_label")),
      
      # Alcohol
      alcohol_frequency = get_col(., c("alcohol_frequency", "dafc")),
      alcohol_amount = get_col(., c("alcohol_drinks_day", "dadtd")),
      alcohol_binge = get_col(., c("alcohol_binge", "alcohol_bingre_frequency", "bingre", "dabf")),
      
      # Labs (Ensure existence)
      alt = get_col(., c("alt", "ALT")),
      ast = get_col(., c("ast", "AST")),
      platelets = get_col(., c("platelets", "plts", "PLATELETS")),
      albumin = get_col(., c("albumin", "alb", "ALB")),
      creatinine = get_col(., c("creatinine", "creat", "CREAT")),
      
      # Anthropometrics (Ensure existence)
      height = get_col(., c("height", "hgt")),
      weight = get_col(., c("weight", "wgt")),
      bmi = get_col(., c("bmi", "BMI")),
      
      # FibroScan Validity
      fibro_valid = get_col(., c("fibro_valid", "valid_scan", "validity", "valid"))
    ) %>%
    select(
      study,
      id, # Select the standardized ID column we just created
      
      any_of(c("age", "gender", "ethnicity", "aboriginal", "hiv", "hcv", "hbv")),
      
      # Liver
      any_of(c("fsm", "fibro_valid")), 
      
      # Labs
      alt, ast, platelets, albumin, creatinine,
      
      # Anthropometrics
      height, weight, bmi,
      
      # Alcohol
      any_of(c("alcohol_frequency", "alcohol_amount", "alcohol_binge"))
    )
}

parse_binary01 <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_chr) | x_chr == "" ~ NA_real_,
    x_chr %in% c("1", "yes", "y", "true", "t", "valid") ~ 1,
    x_chr %in% c("0", "no", "n", "false", "f", "invalid") ~ 0,
    !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))) ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr)),
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

process_study <- function(df, study_name) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)

  restricted_aboriginal_studies <- c("CEASE", "DARLO-C", "Defeat", "Simplify")
  
  # Step 1: Initial Count
  n_total <- nrow(df)
  
  # Prepare variables
  df_proc <- df %>%
    standardize_cols()
    
  df_clean <- df_proc %>%
    mutate(
      # Ensure numeric types
      age = as.numeric(age),
      fsm = as.numeric(fsm),
      fibro_valid = parse_binary01(fibro_valid),
      across(any_of(c("alt", "ast", "albumin", "creatinine", "platelets", "height", "weight", "bmi")), as.numeric),
      
      # Normalize Gender strings
      gender = case_when(
        is.na(gender) | stringr::str_trim(as.character(gender)) == "" ~ NA_character_,
        str_detect(gender, "(?i)female|woman|^2$") ~ "Female",
        str_detect(gender, "(?i)male|man|^1$") ~ "Male",
        str_detect(gender, "(?i)trans|^3$") ~ "Transgender",
        TRUE ~ "Other/Unknown"
      ),
      
      # Normalize Aboriginal Status
      aboriginal = case_when(
        str_detect(aboriginal, "(?i)aboriginal|indigenous|tsi|first nations|koori|murri|yes|pos|^1$") ~ "Indigenous",
        str_detect(aboriginal, "(?i)non|no|neg|^0$|^2$") ~ "Non-Indigenous", 
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      aboriginal = if_else(study %in% restricted_aboriginal_studies, NA_character_, aboriginal),
      
      # Normalize HIV strings
      hiv = case_when(
        str_detect(hiv, "(?i)pos|yes|reactive|1") ~ "Positive",
        str_detect(hiv, "(?i)neg|no|non|0") ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      # HCV (Ensure numeric 1/0 for filtering)
      # If missing, assume 0 (not HCV/unknown)? The instruction says "include those that are 1".
      # We will rely on explicit 1 for inclusion.
      hcv = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(hcv)),
      
      # Normalize HBV strings
      hbv = case_when(
        str_detect(hbv, "(?i)pos|yes|reactive") ~ "Positive",
        str_detect(hbv, "(?i)neg|no|non") ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      # Metavir Categories
      metavir = case_when(
        fsm >= 12.5 ~ "≥12.5 kPa",
        fsm >= 10.0 ~ "10.0–12.49 kPa",
        fsm >= 7.1  ~ "7.1–9.99 kPa",
        fsm < 7.1   ~ "<7.1 kPa",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
      metavir = factor(
      metavir,
      levels = c("<7.1 kPa", "7.1–9.99 kPa", "10.0–12.49 kPa", "≥12.5 kPa"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
      
      # High Baseline Stiffness (>=20 kPa)
      fsm_20 = if_else(fsm > 20, 1, 0),
      
      # Fibro Valid (Fill NA with 1 - assumed valid if not specified)
      #fibro_valid = replace_na(as.numeric(fibro_valid), 1),
      
      # APRI
      apri = (ast / 40) / (platelets / 100),
      apri_cat = case_when(
        apri > 2.0 ~ ">2.0",
        apri > 1.0 ~ "1.0-2.0",
        apri <= 1.0 ~ "<=1.0",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      # FIB-4
      fib4 = (age * ast) / (platelets * sqrt(alt)),
      fib4_cat = case_when(
        fib4 > 3.25 ~ ">3.25",
        fib4 >= 1.45 ~ "1.45-3.25",
        fib4 < 1.45 ~ "<1.45",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      # Alcohol Normalization
      alcohol_binge_cat = case_when(
        str_detect(alcohol_binge, "(?i)daily|day|4|5|almost|5") ~ "Daily or almost daily",
        str_detect(alcohol_binge, "(?i)week|2.*3.*week|4") ~ "Weekly",
        str_detect(alcohol_binge, "(?i)less.*month|month.*less|2") ~ "Less than monthly",
        str_detect(alcohol_binge, "(?i)^monthly|month|2.*4.*month|3") ~ "Monthly",
        str_detect(alcohol_binge, "(?i)^never|no|none|1") ~ "Never",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      alcohol_frequency_cat = case_when(
        str_detect(alcohol_frequency, "(?i)4.*more.*week|^5") ~ "4 or more times a week",
        str_detect(alcohol_frequency, "(?i)2.*3.*week|^4$") ~ "2 to 3 times a week",
        str_detect(alcohol_frequency, "(?i)2.*4.*month|^3$") ~ "2 to 4 times a month",
        str_detect(alcohol_frequency, "(?i)monthly.*less|less.*monthly|^2$") ~ "Monthly or less",
        str_detect(alcohol_frequency, "(?i)^never|no|none|^1$") ~ "Never",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      alcohol_amount_cat = case_when(
        str_detect(alcohol_amount, "(?i)10.*more|^5$") ~ "10 or more",
        str_detect(alcohol_amount, "(?i)7.*9|^4$") ~ "7 to 9",
        str_detect(alcohol_amount, "(?i)5.*6|^3$") ~ "5 or 6",
        str_detect(alcohol_amount, "(?i)3.*4|^2$") ~ "3 or 4",
        str_detect(alcohol_amount, "(?i)1.*2|^1$") ~ "1 or 2",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      # AUDIT-C
      audit_freq_score = as.numeric(factor(alcohol_frequency_cat, levels = c("Never", "Monthly or less", "2 to 4 times a month", "2 to 3 times a week", "4 or more times a week"))) - 1,
      audit_amount_score = as.numeric(factor(alcohol_amount_cat, levels = c("1 or 2", "3 or 4", "5 or 6", "7 to 9", "10 or more"))) - 1,
      audit_binge_score = as.numeric(factor(alcohol_binge_cat, levels = c("Never", "Less than monthly", "Monthly", "Weekly", "Daily or almost daily"))) - 1,
      
      audit_amount_score = if_else(!is.na(audit_freq_score) & audit_freq_score == 0 & is.na(audit_amount_score), 0, audit_amount_score),
      audit_binge_score = if_else(!is.na(audit_freq_score) & audit_freq_score == 0 & is.na(audit_binge_score), 0, audit_binge_score),
      audit_c_score = audit_freq_score + audit_amount_score + audit_binge_score
    ) %>%
    select(
      study, id, 
      age, gender, ethnicity, aboriginal,
      hiv, hbv, hcv,
      fsm, metavir, fsm_20, fibro_valid,
      fib4, fib4_cat, apri, apri_cat,
      alcohol_frequency_cat, alcohol_amount_cat, alcohol_binge_cat, audit_c_score,
      alt, ast, platelets, albumin, creatinine,
      height, weight, bmi
    )
    
  # --- FILTER FLOW & DIAGRAM ---
  
  # MARKING instead of filtering
  df_final <- df_clean %>%
    mutate(
      excluded_hcv = is.na(hcv) | hcv != 1,
      excluded_missing_fsm = !excluded_hcv & is.na(fsm),
      # If we can't confirm validity (fibro_valid is NA), exclude.
      excluded_invalid_fsm = !excluded_hcv & !excluded_missing_fsm & (is.na(fibro_valid) | fibro_valid != 1),
      included_step1 = !excluded_hcv & !excluded_missing_fsm & !excluded_invalid_fsm,
      excluded_missing_age = included_step1 & is.na(age),
      included_step2 = included_step1 & !excluded_missing_age
    )

  # 1. HCV Filter
  n_hcv_excluded <- sum(df_final$excluded_hcv)
  n_hcv_kept <- sum(!df_final$excluded_hcv)
  
  # 2. Missing FibroScan Filter
  n_fsm_excluded <- sum(df_final$excluded_missing_fsm)
  n_fsm_kept <- sum(!df_final$excluded_hcv & !df_final$excluded_missing_fsm)
  
  # 3. Invalid FibroScan Filter
  n_valid_excluded <- sum(df_final$excluded_invalid_fsm, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # 4. Missing age (final analysis cohort)
  n_age_excluded <- sum(df_final$excluded_missing_age, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_final_count <- sum(df_final$included_step2, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Generate Flow Diagram
  if (n_total > 0) {
    # DiagrammeR GraphViz
    # Using simple boxes
    diagram_code <- glue::glue("
      digraph flow {{
        graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB]
        node [shape = box, style = filled, fillcolor = white]
        
        tab1 [label = 'Total Records\\n(n = {n_total})']
        tab2 [label = 'HCV Not Detected / Missing\\n(n = {n_hcv_excluded})', fillcolor = '#ffcccc']
        tab3 [label = 'HCV Detected\\n(n = {n_hcv_kept})']
        tab4 [label = 'Missing FibroScan\\n(n = {n_fsm_excluded})', fillcolor = '#ffcccc']
        tab5 [label = 'FibroScan Available\\n(n = {n_fsm_kept})']
        tab6 [label = 'Invalid FibroScan\\n(n = {n_valid_excluded})', fillcolor = '#ffcccc']
        tab7 [label = 'Valid Analysis Population\\n(n = {n_final_count})', fillcolor = '#ccffcc']
        
        tab1 -> tab3
        tab1 -> tab2 [style=dotted]
        tab3 -> tab5
        tab3 -> tab4 [style=dotted]
        tab5 -> tab7
        tab5 -> tab6 [style=dotted]
      }}
    ")
    
    DiagrammeR::grViz(diagram_code)
    
    # Save diagram source
    dir.create("Results/Descriptives", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    dir.create("Results/FlowDiagrams", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    file_name_dot <- paste0("Results/FlowDiagrams/Flow_", gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9]', '_', study_name), ".dot")
    cat(diagram_code, file = file_name_dot)
    
    # Save stats
    stats_df <- tibble(
      Study = study_name,
      Total = n_total,
      Excluded_HCV = n_hcv_excluded,
      Kept_HCV = n_hcv_kept,
      Excluded_MissingFSM = n_fsm_excluded,
      Kept_HasFSM = n_fsm_kept,
      Excluded_InvalidFSM = n_valid_excluded,
      Excluded_MissingAge = n_age_excluded,
      Final_Analysis = n_final_count
    )
    
    stats_file <- "Results/Descriptives/Study_Flow_Counts.csv"
    write_csv(stats_df, stats_file, append = file.exists(stats_file))
  }
  
  return(df_final)
  return(diagram_code)
}

df_darlo_raw <- df_darlo_raw %>%
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(difftime(date_enrolled, date_birth, units = "days")) / 365.25
  )
```

# Process and Merge

```{r}
# Clear the flow counts file before starting
if (file.exists("Results/Descriptives/Study_Flow_Counts.csv")) {
  file.remove("Results/Descriptives/Study_Flow_Counts.csv")
}

# Apply
clean_ethos    <- process_study(df_ethos_raw, "ETHOS Engage")
clean_reach    <- process_study(df_reach_raw, "REACH-C")
clean_defeat   <- process_study(df_defeat_raw, "Defeat")
clean_simplify <- process_study(df_simplify_raw, "Simplify")
clean_sharp_c  <- process_study(df_sharp_c_raw, "SHARP-C")
clean_stop_c   <- process_study(df_stop_c_raw, "STOP-C")
clean_cease    <- process_study(df_cease_raw, "CEASE")
clean_darlo    <- process_study(df_darlo_raw, "DARLO-C")
clean_liverlife <- process_study(df_liverlife_raw, "LiverLife")
clean_scalec   <- process_study(df_scalec_raw, "Scale-C")
clean_poct     <- process_study(df_poct_raw, "Australian PoC Testing Program")
clean_tempo_rct <- process_study(df_tempo_rct_raw, "TEMPO")
# clean_tempo_pilot <- process_study(df_tempo_pilot_raw, "TEMPO-Pilot")

# Merge
df_final <- bind_rows(
  clean_ethos,
  clean_reach,
  clean_defeat,
  clean_simplify,
  clean_sharp_c,
  clean_stop_c,
  clean_cease,
  clean_darlo,
  clean_liverlife,
  clean_scalec,
  clean_poct,
  clean_tempo_rct#,
  # clean_tempo_pilot
)
```

```{r}
#Create hazardous alcohol use variable based on AUDIT-C score
df_final <- df_final %>%
  mutate(
    hazardous_alcohol_use = case_when(
      is.na(audit_c_score) ~ NA_character_,
      is.na(gender) ~ NA_character_,
      gender == "Male" & audit_c_score >= 4 ~ "Yes",
      gender == "Female" & audit_c_score >= 3 ~ "Yes",
      gender == "Transgender" & audit_c_score >= 3 ~ "Yes", # Using
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  )
```
